title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
source: matrix of shnid 122508 (source 1 AUD) and shnid 116498 (source 2 SBD); matrixed by Monte Barry

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording praised for its lively audience presence and a strong Dark Star/Eyes of the World segment
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this matrix source, noting that the blend of soundboard and crowd captures the concert’s energy, especially during the Dark Star and Eyes‑of‑the‑World stretch. The recording is described as clear and enjoyable with no technical complaints.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights a great performance and solid matrix sound; a second 0‑star note adds uncertainty, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend praised for clarity and lively audience ambience; no specific dropouts or muffling reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners appreciate the smooth flow captured by the matrix, especially the transition into Dark Star.
